problem: The bullet says the ensemble is 'the collection of all possible paths at a fixed time'. Paths run over time, so they cannot sit 'at a fixed time'. The bullet also clashes with the earlier sentence in the same section, which says the ensemble at a fixed t is the set of values of X(t) across outcomes.
fix: The ensemble is the whole family of sample paths of the process, one for each outcome. Fixing a time t and reading across the ensemble gives the random variable X(t); averaging those values is the ensemble average.
